chapter: Rabbit Foot show and show life
title: The Ma Rainey on the Rabbit Foot Show and Big Mary
summary: The Ma Rainey on the show was a Memphis woman, not the original from Columbus, Georgia; Big Mary also sang blues.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Do you remember any famous singers? Like, for instance, I've heard that Ma Rainey was once with the Rabbit Foot. Whether it was the same one that you worked for, I don't know. I just wondered if you ever remember playing with any famous singers or hearing them with any of your shows.

Well, there was a Ma Rainey. Used to work with the Rabbit Foot show, but it wasn't the original Ma Rainey. It wasn't the original? No, it was a Ma Rainey that lives in Memphis, Tennessee. Oh, yeah. See, this one came from- See, Ma Rainey originally from-
Might have been Macon, Georgia or someplace. I forget the town.
I used to know. Columbus, Georgia.

The original Ma Rainey from Columbus, Georgia. Well, there was a Ma Rainey on the Rabbit Show, I remember. But it wasn't the original Ma Rainey that I remember. I remember there's a lady in Memphis, Tennessee, calls herself Ma Rainey.

Yeah, but she's not the original Ma Rainey. She just calls herself Ma Rainey. Well, I remember her singing over there. She was the blues singer there a little while. Then I remember a woman over there called Big Mary, was the blues singer on the Rabbit Foot Show. Big Mary, that's all I know about her. Big Mary. I see a Mizzou, no, that's it.
Somebody with a name similar to that made some records in Chicago about five or six years ago.
